enabled.description: Enable or disable the message forwarder

source_channel_id.hint: The Discord channel ID to forward messages FROM. Enable Developer Mode in Discord and right-click the channel to copy the ID.

destination_channel_id.hint: The Discord channel ID to forward messages TO. Enable Developer Mode in Discord and right-click the channel to copy the ID.

forward_text.hint: Include text content from forwarded messages

include_sender_info.hint: Add sender name and ID to forwarded messages

ignore_bot_messages.hint: Skip forwarding messages sent by Discord bots
